source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 2 · lesson 2. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: One and Alone, and in need of nothing

learn.en: Allah is One and Alone. He has no partner, no adviser and no helper. He created everything alone.
learn.title: One and Alone

learn.en: It is Allah who holds the sky up and keeps the earth in its place. He created seven heavens, one above another.
learn.title: Holding the sky

learn.en: He gives food but does not need food. He protects but does not need protecting. Every creature needs Him.
learn.title: He needs nothing

learn.en: Day and night, ships on the sea, rain from the sky — these are signs for people who think.
learn.title: Signs for thinkers

learn.en: Everything we have is from Allah, so we worship Him alone and ask only Him for help.
learn.title: Ask only Allah

learn.en: “His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, ‘Be,’ and it is.” (Qur'an 36:82)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

quiz.en: True or false? Allah has a partner who helps Him.
True or false? Allah needs food just like us.
True or false? Everyone in the heavens and the earth needs Allah's help.
How many heavens did Allah create?
Who should we ask for help?

think.q: Rain, night and day are “signs for people who think”. What do they tell you about Allah?
think.a: That He is powerful, wise and caring — and that He alone runs everything.

parents.summary: Allah is One, with no partner or helper; He needs nothing, while everything needs Him — so we worship and ask Him alone.
parents.tip: Watch the sunset together and talk about it as one of Allah's signs.
